contradictions: The hypothesis states that all ad-pipeline metrics are healthy, but the probe 'ads_pod_seconds_filled' has a value of 0.875.
This value indicates that ad pods are, on average, only 87.5% full, leaving 12.5% of the available ad time unmonetized.
This is a technical fault known as 'ad pod duration underfill' (F09) and directly explains the observed revenue leak without requiring a downstream billing error.
An impression gap is not expected with underfill, as no ad was served in the empty portion of the pod, so no impression beacon was expected to fire. The zero impression gap is consistent with F09.
